cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Take the Consequence
cards.instruction: Get them to accept responsibility for carrying out the cost, penalty, or unpleasant next step.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. You said you'd announce the budget cut if your plan cost more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then the announcement can be slightly apologetic.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I could. But the bargain gave you this development opportunity.
